title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2022
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
content:
In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) read with clauses (j) and (q) of sub-section (2) of section 52 of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010), the Central Government hereby makes the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2022.

Amendments to Rule 6:
In rule 6, in sub-rule (1), for clause (d), the pre-packer or manufacturer may declare either the month and year of manufacture or the month and year of pre-packing or import, affording compliance flexibility for industrial packaging operations.

rules.heading: Date of Manufacture or Pre-packing Flexibility
rules.text: Flexibility in declaring either month and year of manufacture or pre-packing.

subrules.heading: Manufacture vs Pre-packing Date Option
subrules.text: The manufacturer or packer may at their option declare either the month and year of manufacture or the month and year of pre-packing, provided such declaration is clearly legible.
